senses.definitionCN: 一次旅行，尤指长距离的
senses.example: The journey across the mountains took three days.
senses.exampleCN: 翻山那一趟走了三天。
senses.why: The basic sense is simply travel between two named places.
senses.whyCN: 最基本的义项就是两个地名之间的一趟走动。

senses.title: The distance travelled
senses.definition: the length of time or distance covered by travelling
senses.definitionCN: 旅行所花的时间或所走的路程
senses.example: It is a two-hour journey by bus.
senses.exampleCN: 坐公交要两个钟头的路程。
senses.why: The same word names the length of the trip, not only the trip itself.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词也指这趟路的长度，而不只是这趟出行。

senses.title: A process of change
senses.definition: a long personal or collective process of growth or change
senses.definitionCN: 个人或集体长期成长与改变的历程
senses.example: Learning the language was a journey of small victories.
senses.exampleCN: 学这门语言是一段由许多小胜利组成的历程。
senses.why: Modern English extended the road image to any long process of change.
senses.whyCN: 现代英语把「路」的意象扩展到任何长期的改变过程。

intro.en: Journey began as French journée, "a day", because travel was measured in days.
intro.cn: journey 起初是法语 journée「一天」，因为旅程是按天来算的。

items.en: diurnus meant "of the day", from dies, "day".
items.cn: diurnus 意为「一天的」，来自 dies「日」。

items.en: journee meant "a day's work or a day's travel".
items.cn: journee 意为「一天的活儿或一天的行程」。

items.en: English took it as journee, still meaning a day's travel.
items.cn: 英语借作 journee，仍指一天的行程。

items.en: The meaning widened from one day to any trip.
items.cn: 词义从「一天」扩到「任何一趟行程」。

items.en: Modern usage adds the inner sense of a process of change.
items.cn: 现代用法又添了「内在历程」这一层。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the journ- stem; the near-meaning group holds words for travelling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 journ- 词干；近义组收表示旅行的词。

entries.definition: A daily record or a magazine.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「日记；期刊」，同词干。

entries.definition: A skilled worker paid by the day.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「熟练工」，原文为按日计酬。

entries.definition: A person who writes for the news.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「记者」，同词干。

entries.definition: A short journey for pleasure or business.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「一趟」，多指短程。

entries.definition: A long journey by sea or space.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「航行」，多指海上或太空。

entries.definition: A journey visiting several places.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「游览」，多点巡回。

normalIntro.en: These hooks measure the word in days, as the French did.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子像法国人那样，用「天」来量这个词。

normal.en: jour means day in French.
normal.cn: jour 在法语里是「白天」。

normal.en: A journey was once just a day of travel.
normal.cn: journey 原本只是一天的行程。

normal.en: Longer trips needed more jours, so the meaning grew.
normal.cn: 更长的路要更多「日」，词义就扩大了。

normal.en: A journal is what you write at the end of the day.
normal.cn: journal 是一天结束时写下的东西。

normal.en: Learning is a journey without a station.
normal.cn: 学习是一趟没有站台的旅程。

abstract.en: A journey is a straight line bent by weather.
abstract.cn: 旅程是一条被天气弄弯的直线。

abstract.en: The road is measured in days, the change in years.
abstract.cn: 路用天来量，改变用年来量。

abstract.en: Some journeys end where the traveller begins.
abstract.cn: 有些旅程的终点，正是出发时的自己。

examples.en: The journey from the coast to the capital takes a whole day.
examples.cn: 从海边到首都这一趟要一整天。

examples.en: She kept a notebook of every journey she took.
examples.cn: 她每一趟出行都记在一个本子上。

examples.en: His journey from factory worker to teacher took ten years.
examples.cn: 他从工人到教师的这条路走了十年。

dict_mnemonic.text: jour（日）+ ney —— 一段按日子数的路

root: 拉丁语 dies「日」→ diurnus「一日的」→ 古法语 journee「一天的行程」→ 中古英语 journee → 现代英语 journey。同族有 journal、journeyman、journalist。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: travelling somewhere, the distance covered, and a long inner process.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：出门远行、所走的路程，以及长期的成长历程。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a road starting at the horizon and going out of sight.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条从地平线起、伸到看不见尽头的路。

branches.en: THE PLATFORM: bags waiting for the departure.
branches.cn: 站台这条线：等着出发的行李。

branches.en: THE MILEAGE: the hours and miles the trip costs.
branches.cn: 里程这条线：这一趟花掉的时间与里数。

branches.en: THE CHANGE: an inner road from one self to another.
branches.cn: 改变这条线：从旧的自己走到新的自己。

branches.en: THE CLOCK: both senses count the trip in time.
branches.cn: 时钟这条线：两个义项都用时间来数一趟路。

branches.en: THE PATIENCE: distance and growth both take days.
branches.cn: 耐心这条线：路程与成长都要一天一天来。

intro.en: Journey is borrowed from French with its day-root jour- intact.
intro.cn: journey 从法语整词借来，含「日」的词根 jour- 完好保留。

latinIntro.en: Latin dies and diurnus stand behind the French word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 dies 与 diurnus 藏在法语词背后。

items.example: The root also appears in journal.

items.exampleCN: 它标出「一整天」这段长度。
英语把 journee 改成 journey。
同一个月「日」的词根，写了下来。

definition_en: a strong feeling of happiness, or a person or thing that causes it
core_image: 一个人听见好消息，脸上的光一下子亮起来
scene: 门口传来钥匙转动的声音，孩子跑过去，扑进刚下班的父母怀里。Her face lit with joy when the letter arrived.
sceneCN: 这里 joy 是「喜悦」（第 1 个义项：强烈的快乐情绪），句意为信到时她脸上立刻亮起喜悦。画面里的物件：门口、信件、灯光。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ful 构成，义为「快乐的」
由本词加 -ous 构成，义为「充满喜悦的」
加前缀 en- 构成，义为「享受」
由本词加 -less 构成，义为「毫无乐趣的」

senses.title: A strong happy feeling
senses.definition: a deep feeling of delight and gladness
senses.definitionCN: 深切的喜悦与高兴
senses.example: The children shouted with joy when the snow began.
senses.exampleCN: 雪一下起来，孩子们就欢呼起来。
senses.why: The first sense is the feeling itself, with no object attached.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项是情绪本身，不牵扯具体对象。

senses.title: A source of happiness
senses.definition: a person or thing that brings great pleasure
senses.definitionCN: 带来极大快乐的人或事物
senses.example: That old cat is the joy of her life.
senses.exampleCN: 那只老猫是她生活里的欢乐。
senses.why: English often turns a feeling word into the thing that causes it.
senses.whyCN: 英语常把表示感受的词转成引起感受的那个东西。

senses.title: Success in informal speech
senses.definition: a sense of achievement, mostly in the phrase "no joy"
senses.definitionCN: 取得成效的感觉，多见于 no joy 这一说法
senses.example: We tried twice and got no joy, so we called again.
senses.exampleCN: 我们试了两次都没成功，只好又打电话。
senses.why: In informal speech the word also measures whether an attempt worked.
senses.whyCN: 在口语里，这个词还用来衡量一次尝试有没有成。

intro.en: Joy comes from Old French joie, from Latin gaudium, "gladness", from the verb gaudere, "to rejoice".
intro.cn: joy 来自古法语 joie，源自拉丁语 gaudium「喜乐」，后者来自动词 gaudere「欢乐」。

items.en: gaudere meant "to be glad, to rejoice".
items.cn: gaudere 意为「高兴、欢欣」。

items.en: The noun gaudium meant "gladness".
items.cn: 名词 gaudium 意为「喜乐」。

items.en: French softened it to joie.
items.cn: 法语把它软化成 joie。

items.en: English took joie as joy and kept the feeling sense.
items.cn: 英语借作 joy，保留了情感义。

items.en: Idioms like "jump for joy" fixed the word in everyday speech.
items.cn: jump for joy 一类成语把它固定在日常语里。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the j- opening and the feeling family; the near-meaning group holds words for happiness.
note.cn: 形近组共用 j- 开头与同一情感家族；近义组收表示快乐的词。

entries.definition: To get pleasure from something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「享受」，同词根。

entries.definition: Full of joy.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「快乐的」，同族词。

entries.definition: Cheerful in a lively way.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「快活的」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: Great pleasure, often sudden.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「欣喜」，常指突然的。

entries.definition: A quiet state of being pleased.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「高兴」，偏安静。

entries.definition: The general state of being happy.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「幸福」，最宽泛。

normalIntro.en: These hooks trace the word back through French to a Latin verb for rejoicing.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它经法语追到拉丁语里那个「欢欣」的动词。

normal.en: gaudere is Latin for to be glad.
normal.cn: gaudere 是拉丁语「高兴」。

normal.en: gaudium became joie in French.
normal.cn: gaudium 在法语里成了 joie。

normal.en: joie crossed the Channel as joy.
normal.cn: joie 跨过海峡变成 joy。

normal.en: en- plus joy makes enjoy.
normal.cn: en- 加 joy 就是 enjoy。

normal.en: Add -ful and the feeling fills the word.
normal.cn: 加 -ful，这个词就装满了这种感觉。

abstract.en: Joy is a door opened by surprise.
abstract.cn: 喜悦是一扇被意外推开的门。

abstract.en: The brightest minutes leave the smallest receipts.
abstract.cn: 最亮的那些分钟，留下最小的票据。

abstract.en: A joy shared is simply a joy doubled.
abstract.cn: 分享的快乐，就是把快乐翻一倍。

examples.en: She could not hide her joy at the news.
examples.cn: 听到这个消息，她掩不住喜悦。

examples.en: The garden has been a joy since spring.
examples.cn: 从春天起，这个花园就一直让人愉快。

examples.en: I called the office twice but had no joy.
examples.cn: 我给办公室打了两次电话，都没办成。

dict_mnemonic.text: joie（法语「快乐」）——脸上的那道光

root: 拉丁语 gaudere「欢欣」→ gaudium「喜乐」→ 古法语 joie → 中古英语 joy。同族有 enjoy、joyful、joyous、joyless。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: a strong happy feeling, a source of happiness, and the informal sense of success.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：强烈的快乐情绪、带来快乐的人或事，以及口语中的「顺利」。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face lighting up at good news.
core.cn: 核心意象：听到好消息时一下亮起来的脸。

branches.en: THE LIGHT: the feeling itself, sudden and warm.
branches.cn: 光这条线：那种突然而温暖的情绪本身。

branches.en: THE CAT: a small thing that keeps giving pleasure.
branches.cn: 猫这条线：源源不断带来快乐的小东西。

branches.en: THE CALL: no joy means the attempt failed.
branches.cn: 电话这条线：no joy 就是没办成。

branches.en: THE GIFT: feelings and their causes share one word.
branches.cn: 礼物这条线：情绪与引起它的事物共用一词。

branches.en: THE OUTCOME: what turns out well becomes a joy.
branches.cn: 结果这条线：办成的事也成了乐事。

intro.en: Joy is a short, old French stem; the endings are where the learning happens.
intro.cn: joy 是个短小的古法语词干，可学的是它后面加的各种词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin gaudere and gaudium are both recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 gaudere 与 gaudium 均有记载。

items.example: The root hides behind the French form.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根藏在法语形式后面。

items.example: It forms enjoy, to put joy into.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 enjoy，把快乐放进去。

items.example: The verb is the family base.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词是这一族的基座。

items.example: The noun became joie in French.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词在法语里变成 joie。

definition_en: a person who decides cases in court or scores a contest, or to form an opinion about something after thinking
core_image: 一个人坐在高台后，手里握着木槌，眼前是两方对立的说法
scene: 法庭里所有人都安静下来，高台上的那个人翻开卷宗说了第一句话。The judge asked the witness to speak more slowly.
sceneCN: 这里 judge 是「法官」（第 1 个义项：法庭上作出裁决的人），句意为法官请证人说得慢一些。画面里的物件：木槌、卷宗、高台。

collocations.phrase: as far as I can judge

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -ment 构成，义为「判断；判决」
同源于 judex 词干的形容词，义为「司法的」
加前缀 mis- 构成，义为「误判」
同带 judic- 词根的形近词，义为「偏见」

senses.title: Person in a court
senses.definition: the official who hears a case and decides it according to law
senses.definitionCN: 审理案件并依法裁决的官员
senses.example: The judge gave him a fine and a warning.
senses.exampleCN: 法官判他罚款并给予警告。
senses.why: The formal sense is the oldest and still the defining one.
senses.whyCN: 正式义最古老，至今仍是这个词的定型义。

senses.title: Person who scores a contest
senses.definition: a person who decides the result of a competition
senses.definitionCN: 决定比赛结果的人
senses.example: One judge gave the singer full marks.
senses.exampleCN: 有一位评委给这位歌手打了满分。
senses.why: The same Latin compound covered any declared verdict, including a panel of scorers.
senses.whyCN: 同一个拉丁复合词也涵盖任何宣告的裁决，包括评委打分。

senses.title: Forming an opinion
senses.definition: to reach a conclusion about someone or something after thought
senses.definitionCN: 经过思考对人或事得出结论
senses.example: Do not judge the plan until you see the figures.
senses.exampleCN: 没看到数字之前先别评判这个方案。
senses.why: Everyday English dropped the courtroom and kept the weighing of evidence.
senses.whyCN: 日常英语丢掉了法庭，只留下权衡证据这一层。

senses.title: Deciding a case
senses.definition: to hear evidence and give a legal decision
senses.definitionCN: 听取证据并作出法律裁决
senses.example: The court will judge the case next month.
senses.exampleCN: 法院下个月审理此案。
senses.why: The verb sense is the noun turned around: to act the part of the judge.
senses.whyCN: 动词义是名词的翻转：去充当法官这个角色。

intro.en: Judge comes from Latin judex, built from jus "law" and dicere "to say": the one who says the law.
intro.cn: judge 来自拉丁语 judex，由 jus「法」与 dicere「说」构成：说出法律的人。

items.en: jus or ius meant "law, right".
items.cn: jus 或 ius 意为「法、权利」。

items.en: dicere meant "to say, to declare".
items.cn: dicere 意为「说、宣告」。

items.en: judex joined them: the one who declares the law.
items.cn: judex 把两者合起来：宣告法律的人。

items.en: French turned judex into juge.
items.cn: 法语把 judex 变成 juge。

items.en: English spelt it judge and extended it to any opinion.
items.cn: 英语写作 judge，并把词义扩展到任何意见。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the jud- root; the near-meaning group holds words for deciding and evaluating.
note.cn: 形近组共用 jud- 词根；近义组收表示裁定与评价的词。

entries.definition: The act of forming an opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「判断」，同族词。

entries.definition: Relating to courts of law.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「司法的」，同词根。

entries.definition: An opinion formed without evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「偏见」，同词根加 pre-。

entries.definition: To estimate the quality or size of something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「评估」，偏测量。

entries.definition: To decide the value of something carefully.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「评价」，偏价值。

entries.definition: The official who controls a match.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「裁判」，多用于球赛。

normalIntro.en: These hooks split the word into law plus say.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它拆成「法」加「说」。

normal.en: jus means law and dicere means say.
normal.cn: jus 是法，dicere 是说。

normal.en: A judge is the one who says the law out loud.
normal.cn: judge 就是把法律当场说出来的人。

normal.en: A referee judges a match; a judge tries a case.
normal.cn: referee 判比赛，judge 审案子。

normal.en: To judge is to give a verdict in your own mind.
normal.cn: judge 作动词，就是在心里下一个结论。

normal.en: Add -ment and you have the verdict itself.
normal.cn: 加 -ment 就得到判决本身。

abstract.en: A judge is a voice that the law speaks through.
abstract.cn: 法官是法律借来说话的那个嗓子。

abstract.en: Judging people is cheap; judging fairly is not.
abstract.cn: 评判别人很便宜，公平地评判不是。

abstract.en: Every judgement leaves a door open to appeal.
abstract.cn: 每一个判断都留着一扇上诉的门。

examples.en: The judge listened to both sides before speaking.
examples.cn: 法官先听完双方才开口。

examples.en: Three judges scored the final dance.
examples.cn: 三位评委为决赛的舞蹈打分。

examples.en: You cannot judge a book by a single page.
examples.cn: 不能只看一页就评判一本书。

dict_mnemonic.text: jus（法）+ dic（说）——把法律说出来的人

root: 拉丁语 jus「法」+ dicere「说」→ judex「宣告法律者」→ 古法语 juge → 英语 judge。同族有 judgement、judicial、prejudice、justice。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: a court judge, a contest judge, forming an opinion, and trying a case.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：法庭法官、比赛裁判、形成判断，以及审理案件。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone seated above two contrary claims with a gavel.
core.cn: 核心意象：在高处握着木槌、面对两种相反说法的人。

branches.en: THE BENCH: the court side, where a case is decided.
branches.cn: 审判席这条线：裁决案件的法庭一面。

branches.en: THE SCORE: the contest side, where marks are given.
branches.cn: 打分这条线：给出分数的一方。

branches.en: THE MIND: the everyday side, where opinions form.
branches.cn: 头脑这条线：日常形成看法的这一面。

branches.en: THE AUTHORITY: formal rulings and private opinions share a shape.
branches.cn: 权威这条线：正式裁决与私下看法形状相同。

branches.en: THE STANDARD: both senses need a measure to compare against.
branches.cn: 标准这条线：两个义项都需要一把衡量的尺。

intro.en: Judge is Latin jus "law" plus the root dic- "say", worn down through French.
intro.cn: judge 是拉丁语 jus「法」加词根 dic-「说」，再经法语磨短而成。

latinIntro.en: Latin jus, dicere and judex are all recorded.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 jus、dicere 与 judex 均有记载。

items.example: The root also appears in judicial and prejudice.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 judicial 与 prejudice。

items.example: The root also appears in dictate and predict.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根也见于 dictate 与 predict。

items.example: The law half of the word.
The speaking half of the word.

definition_en: the liquid squeezed from fruit, vegetables, or meat, or the essential energy of something
core_image: 一只手把橙子对半切开，用力一挤，汁顺着指缝流下来
scene: 夏天的厨房里，桌上摊着果皮和切板，杯子里是刚榨出来的橙红色。A glass of fresh juice is all she wants at breakfast.
sceneCN: 这里 juice 是「果汁」（第 1 个义项：从果实压出的液体），句意为早餐她只想要一杯鲜果汁。画面里的物件：橙子、切板、玻璃杯。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -y 构成，义为「多汁的；有看头的」
由本词加 -er 构成，义为「榨汁机」
由本词加 -less 构成，义为「无汁的」

senses.title: Liquid from fruit
senses.definition: the liquid pressed or squeezed out of fruit or vegetables
senses.definitionCN: 从果实或蔬菜中压出的液体
senses.example: She drinks a glass of carrot juice every morning.
senses.exampleCN: 她每天早上喝一杯胡萝卜汁。
senses.why: The fruit sense is the one English uses every day.
senses.whyCN: 果实的义项是英语每天在用的那一个。

senses.title: Liquid from meat
senses.definition: the natural liquid released from cooked meat
senses.definitionCN: 熟肉里自然渗出的液体
senses.example: Let the chicken rest so the juices stay in.
senses.exampleCN: 让鸡肉静置一会儿，肉汁才不会流失。
senses.why: Meat keeps the older, kitchen sense of the Latin word.
senses.whyCN: 肉汁保留了拉丁词更古老的厨房义。

senses.title: Energy or essence
senses.definition: the power that runs something, or the most essential part of it
senses.definitionCN: 让某物运转的动力，或某物最精华的部分
senses.example: The old radio needs new batteries; it has run out of juice.
senses.exampleCN: 这台老收音机要换电池，它没电了。
senses.why: Modern speech borrowed the liquid image for electric power, then for any energy.
senses.whyCN: 现代口语借「汁」的意象指电力，再扩展到任何能量。

intro.en: Juice came through Old French from Latin jus, which meant broth or juice.
intro.cn: juice 经古法语来自拉丁语 jus，意为肉汤或汁液。

items.en: jus meant "broth, juice, sauce".
items.cn: jus 意为「肉汤、汁、调味汁」。

items.en: French took it as jus, still used for gravy and law.
items.cn: 法语作 jus，既指肉汁也指法。

items.en: The form jus was borrowed into English as juice.
items.cn: jus 这一形式被英语借作 juice。

items.en: English used juice for the liquid of plants and fruit.
items.cn: 英语用 juice 指植物与果实的汁液。

items.en: Electricity gave the word a modern second life.
items.cn: 电力让这个词获得了现代的第二生命。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the jui- opening; the near-meaning group holds words for liquid and its essence.
note.cn: 形近组共用 jui- 开头；近义组收表示液体及其精华的词。

entries.definition: Full of juice, or full of interest.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「多汁的；有看头的」，同族词。

entries.definition: A machine for pressing fruit.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「榨汁机」，同族词。

entries.definition: Very large of its kind.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「特大号的」，拼写开头相同。

entries.definition: The liquid that carries food through a plant.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「树液」，植物生理用词。

entries.definition: Anything that flows and takes the shape of its vessel.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「液体」，最泛。

entries.definition: The most important quality of something.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「精华」，偏抽象。

normalIntro.en: These hooks jump from a squeezed orange to a dying battery.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子从一个挤开的橙子跳到快没电的电池。

normal.en: jus in Latin was broth or juice.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 jus 是肉汤或汁。

normal.en: Squeeze an orange and the juice is what leaves.
normal.cn: 挤一个橙子，离开的就是汁。

normal.en: Add -y and the fruit becomes juicy.
normal.cn: 加 -y，果实就有了汁。

normal.en: A juicer is the machine that does the squeezing.
normal.cn: juicer 就是干这挤活的机器。

normal.en: A device without power has run out of juice too.
normal.cn: 没电的装置，也被说成「没汁了」。

abstract.en: Juice is the inside of a fruit made visible.
abstract.cn: 汁是果实内部露出来的样子。

abstract.en: What is squeezed out loses its shape but keeps its taste.
abstract.cn: 被挤出来的东西失了形状，却保住了味道。

abstract.en: Every engine lives on some kind of juice.
abstract.cn: 每台机器都靠某种「汁」活着。

examples.en: The children shared a carton of apple juice.
examples.cn: 孩子们分喝了一盒苹果汁。

examples.en: Lemon juice keeps sliced apples from browning.
examples.cn: 柠檬汁能让切开的苹果不变褐。

examples.en: The team has plenty of juice left for the last round.
examples.cn: 这支队伍还有足够的体力打最后一轮。

dict_mnemonic.text: juice 与 jus 同形：挤出来的东西

root: 拉丁语 jus「肉汤；汁」→ 古法语 jus → 中古英语 juice。同源有 justice（法）；派生有 juicy、juicer、juiceless。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: fruit liquid, meat juices, and the energy or essence that keeps something going.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：果实汁液、肉汁，以及维持某物的能量或精华。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an orange halved and pressed until liquid runs down the hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：橙子被挤开，汁顺着手指往下流。

branches.en: THE GLASS: fruit pressed into a drink.
branches.cn: 杯子这条线：果实被压成饮料。

branches.en: THE PLATE: meat keeping its liquid on the board.
branches.cn: 盘子这条线：肉在案板上留住汁水。

branches.en: THE BATTERY: the power that makes a thing run.
branches.cn: 电池这条线：让东西运转的动力。

branches.en: THE SQUEEZE: both senses are liquid taken from something.
branches.cn: 挤压这条线：两个义项都是从某物里取出的液体。

branches.en: THE CORE: what is inside is also what is essential.
branches.cn: 内核这条线：里面的东西也就是精华。

intro.en: Juice is a whole Latin stem borrowed through French, with a silent-e ending in English.
intro.cn: juice 是经法语借来的完整拉丁词干，英语里带一个不发音的 -e。

latinIntro.en: Latin jus stands behind juice; justice comes from the same Latin stem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 jus 是 juice 的前身，justice 也出自同一词干。

items.example: It marks the long vowel in juice.
items.exampleCN: 它标出 juice 的长元音。

items.example: French kept both senses of the Latin.
items.exampleCN: 法语保留了拉丁语的两个义项。

items.example: A distant relative that kept the law sense.
The same ending extends the metaphor.
items.exampleCN: 同一词尾把比喻延伸出去。

definition_en: to push yourself off a surface into the air, or to rise or increase suddenly
core_image: 两脚同时离开地面，身体在半空中停住一瞬
scene: 跑道尽头，一个孩子数着数，腿一弯就蹬了出去。He jumped the fence and ran across the field.
sceneCN: 这里 jump 是「跳」（第 1 个义项：双脚蹬离地面），句意为他翻过栅栏穿过田野跑开。画面里的物件：跑道、栅栏、草地。

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -er 构成，义为「跳跃者；毛衣（英式）」
由本词加 -y 构成，义为「紧张不安的」
由本词加 -ing 构成，义为「跳跃运动」

senses.title: Pushing off the ground
senses.definition: to leave the ground by bending the legs and pushing hard
senses.definitionCN: 屈腿用力蹬地离开地面
senses.example: The dog jumped into the water without hesitating.
senses.exampleCN: 那条狗毫不犹豫地跳进水里。
senses.why: The physical sense is the core, and every other use borrows its upward push.
senses.whyCN: 身体动作是核心，其他用法都借了那股向上的蹬力。

senses.title: Rising suddenly
senses.definition: to increase or rise quickly and by a large amount
senses.definitionCN: 迅速大幅度上升
senses.example: Prices jumped by a third in one month.
senses.exampleCN: 价格一个月里猛涨了三分之一。
senses.why: Numbers that rise suddenly behave like something springing up.
senses.whyCN: 突然上升的数字，像有东西弹了起来。

senses.title: Skipping over something
senses.definition: to cross over a fence or gap in one movement
senses.definitionCN: 一个动作跨过栅栏或空隙
senses.example: She jumped the low wall and was gone.
senses.exampleCN: 她跳过矮墙就不见了。
senses.why: The jump also covers the object jumped over.
senses.whyCN: 这个词也涵盖被跳过去的那个东西。

senses.title: Moving on too fast
senses.definition: to pass to a later point without the proper steps
senses.definitionCN: 跳过应有的步骤直接进入后面
senses.example: Do not jump to conclusions before the test results.
senses.exampleCN: 检查结果出来之前别急着下结论。
senses.why: Thinking can leap too, and skipping steps is the risky version.
senses.whyCN: 思维也会跳，跳过步骤就是有风险的那种。

intro.en: Jump is probably imitative, an English word of uncertain origin that simply sounds like a spring.
intro.cn: jump 很可能是拟声词，来源不确定，读音本身就带着一弹。

items.en: The word appears in English in the sixteenth century with no Latin ancestor.
items.cn: 这个词十六世纪出现在英语中，没有拉丁语祖先。

items.en: It was used of leaping animals and people alike.
items.cn: 它同时用于跳跃的动物和人。

items.en: The sense of a sudden rise in price came early.
items.cn: 价格猛涨的义项很早就出现了。

items.en: Sport fixed compounds such as long jump and high jump.
items.cn: 体育固定了 long jump、high jump 这样的复合词。

items.en: Idioms like jump at a chance keep the suddenness.
items.cn: jump at a chance 一类成语保留着那种突然。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the j- and -ump shape; the near-meaning group holds words for leaving the ground.
note.cn: 形近组共用 j- 与 -ump 的外形；近义组收表示离开地面的词。

entries.definition: One who jumps, or a knitted top.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「跳跃者；毛衣」，同族词。

entries.definition: Easily startled.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「容易受惊的」，同族词。

entries.definition: To knock against something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「碰撞」，只差一个字母。

entries.definition: To spring a long way through the air.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「跃」，距离更远。

entries.definition: To move on one leg or in small jumps.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「单脚跳」，幅度小。

entries.definition: To move suddenly upward.
entries.definitionCN: 动词义为「弹起」，强调弹力。

normalIntro.en: These hooks stay with the short, springy sound of the word.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子跟着这个词短促而有弹性的音。

normal.en: Say it fast and the mouth itself springs.
normal.cn: 快说一遍，嘴巴自己就弹了一下。

normal.en: No Latin behind it: the sound is the origin.
normal.cn: 背后没有拉丁语，声音就是来源。

normal.en: Prices jump like a startled animal.
normal.cn: 价格惊跳起来，像受惊的动物。

normal.en: Jump at a chance: the leap comes first, the thought later.
normal.cn: jump at a chance：先跳，后想。

normal.en: Add -y and you are jumpy, ready to startle.
normal.cn: 加 -y 就是 jumpy，随时会惊跳。

abstract.en: A jump is a small rebellion against gravity.
abstract.cn: 跳跃是对重力的一次小小反叛。

abstract.en: What goes up owes the ground a return.
abstract.cn: 跳起来的东西，都欠地面一次回程。

abstract.en: Most leaps are decided before the feet leave.
abstract.cn: 多数跃起，在脚离地之前就决定了。

examples.en: She jumped off the wall and landed badly.
examples.cn: 她从墙上跳下来，落地时扭到了。

examples.en: Sales jumped in the week before the holiday.
examples.cn: 假期前那一周销量猛增。

examples.en: Try not to jump from one idea to the next.
examples.cn: 尽量别从一个念头跳到下一个。

dict_mnemonic.text: jump 读音短促，本身就带一个弹起来的感觉

root: 来源不确定，可能为拟声词，十六世纪出现于英语。派生有 jumper、jumpy；无拉丁语同源。

sensesIntro.en: Four senses: leaving the ground, rising fast, crossing in one move, and skipping ahead.
sensesIntro.cn: 四个义项：蹬地跃起、迅速上升、一跨而过，以及跳过步骤。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: both feet leaving the ground and hanging for a moment.
core.cn: 核心意象：双脚离地，在半空停住一瞬。

branches.en: THE AIR: the body in flight.
branches.cn: 空中这条线：腾起的身体。

branches.en: THE CHART: a line that leaps upward.
branches.cn: 曲线这条线：一下窜上去的线。

branches.en: THE WALL: the fence taken in one move.
branches.cn: 矮墙这条线：一步跨过去的栅栏。

branches.en: THE GAP: steps left out on purpose or by haste.
branches.cn: 空缺这条线：有意或匆忙落下的步骤。

branches.en: THE SURPRISE: both senses break an expected line.
branches.cn: 意外这条线：两个义项都打断了预期。

intro.en: Jump has no prefix or suffix in its base form; it is a single Germanic-style root of uncertain origin.
intro.cn: jump 原形没有前后缀，是一个来源不明的单一词根。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source, so latinEntries stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，所以 latinEntries 留空。

items.example: Sport builds compounds on the word.
items.exampleCN: 体育在它上面造复合词。

definition_zh: 丛林；密林；混乱拥挤之处
definition_en: a thick tropical forest full of tangled plants, or any place that feels crowded and without rules
core_image: 藤蔓从地面爬到树冠，脚下连一步平地都找不到
scene: 雨还没停，树叶上滴着水，道路在十米之外就完全消失了。The path vanished into the jungle after the first bend.
sceneCN: 这里 jungle 是「丛林」（第 1 个义项：热带浓密树林），句意为路拐过第一个弯就消失在丛林里。画面里的物件：藤蔓、树冠、积水。

pos.zh: 名词：丛林；密林；混乱竞争之地

collocations.phrase: cut a path through the jungle

derivatives.zh: 由本词加 -y 构成，义为「丛林般的」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「被丛林覆盖的」
由本词加 -ed 构成，义为「长满丛林的」

senses.title: Thick tropical forest
senses.definition: a forest in a hot wet region where plants grow so thickly that movement is hard
senses.definitionCN: 炎热潮湿地区树木藤蔓密到难以行走的森林
senses.example: Tigers still live in these jungles.
senses.exampleCN: 这些丛林里仍有老虎生活。
senses.why: The geographic sense is the one the word was borrowed for.
senses.whyCN: 地理义正是这个词被借进英语时所指的。

senses.title: A wild, crowded place
senses.definition: a place or situation that feels crowded, lawless, and hard to survive
senses.definitionCN: 拥挤、缺少规则、难以生存的地方或处境
senses.example: The market at noon is a jungle of carts and shouting.
senses.exampleCN: 中午的市场是一片推车与叫喊的丛林。
senses.why: The metaphor uses the forest to talk about crowded, ruleless human places.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻借森林来说拥挤、少规则的人间场所。

senses.title: A mess of things
senses.definition: a confused mass of objects or words
senses.definitionCN: 一堆纠缠不清的物件或文字
senses.example: The report is a jungle of numbers and abbreviations.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告是一团数字与缩写的丛林。
senses.why: The mess sense is the metaphor pushed toward pure confusion.
senses.whyCN: 「杂乱」义是这个比喻推到纯粹的混乱那一端。

intro.en: Jungle came from Hindi jangal, "waste land, forest", which goes back to Sanskrit jangala, "dry ground".
intro.cn: jungle 来自印地语 jangal「荒地、森林」，更早是梵语 jangala「干燥之地」。

items.en: jangala meant "dry, arid land".
items.cn: jangala 意为「干燥荒芜之地」。

items.en: jangal named waste or uncultivated land, often wooded.
items.cn: jangal 指荒废未耕种之地，常长着树。

items.en: English in India used jungle for dense Indian forest.
items.cn: 在印度的英国人用 jungle 指印度浓密森林。

items.en: The word entered general English in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 这个词在十九世纪进入普通英语。

items.en: Kipling and later writing fixed the tropical image.
items.cn: 吉卜林及其后的作品固定了热带丛林的意象。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the jun-/jung- opening; the near-meaning group holds words for dense wild growth.
note.cn: 形近组共用 jun-/jung- 开头；近义组收表示浓密野生植被的词。

entries.definition: Like a jungle, thick and wild.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词义为「丛林般的」，同族词。

entries.definition: A confused mixture of things.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「杂乱的一堆」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: A harsh ringing of metal.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「刺耳声响」，拼写相近。

entries.definition: A dense tropical forest with heavy rain.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「雨林」，偏地理。

entries.definition: Land untouched by people.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「荒野」，无人居住。

entries.definition: A mass of bushes growing close together.
entries.definitionCN: 名词义为「灌木丛」，规模较小。

normalIntro.en: These hooks follow the word back from tropical film scenes to a Sanskrit adjective.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把它从热带电影画面追到梵语形容词。

normal.en: Hindi jangal meant waste or wooded land.
normal.cn: 印地语 jangal 指荒地或有树林的地。

normal.en: Sanskrit jangala meant dry ground.
normal.cn: 梵语 jangala 意为干燥之地。

normal.en: Dry land became wet forest in the English image.
normal.cn: 干燥之地在英语的意象里成了潮湿森林。

normal.en: Jungle law is survival without rules.
normal.cn: jungle law 就是没有规则的生存。

normal.en: A concrete jungle has trees of steel.
normal.cn: 水泥丛林里长的是钢铁做的树。

abstract.en: A jungle is a forest that says no to roads.
abstract.cn: 丛林是一片对道路说不的森林。

abstract.en: Where the vines meet, the ground disappears.
abstract.cn: 藤蔓相接的地方，地面就消失了。

abstract.en: Every crowded market is a small jungle.
abstract.cn: 每个拥挤的市场都是一小片丛林。

examples.en: The village sits at the edge of a thick jungle.
examples.cn: 这个村子坐落在浓密丛林的边上。

examples.en: New staff soon learn the jungle of office politics.
examples.cn: 新员工很快就摸清了办公室政治的丛林。

examples.en: The notebook was a jungle of arrows and odd words.
examples.cn: 那本笔记是一团箭头和怪词组成的丛林。

dict_mnemonic.text: jangal（印地语「荒地、树林」）—— 密到走不动的森林

root: 梵语 jangala「干燥之地」→ 印地语 jangal「荒地；树林」→ 英印英语 jungle → 现代英语 jungle。同族有 jungly、jungled。

sensesIntro.en: Three senses: tropical thick forest, a crowded lawless place, and a tangled mess.
sensesIntro.cn: 三个义项：热带密林、拥挤无规则之地，以及杂乱的一团。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: vines climbing from soil to canopy with no flat ground left.
core.cn: 核心意象：藤蔓从地面爬到树冠，脚下没有平地。

branches.en: THE PATH: a route that vanishes after one bend.
branches.cn: 小径这条线：拐过一个弯就消失的路。

branches.en: THE MARKET: a crowd where rules seem absent.
branches.cn: 市场这条线：规则像是缺席的人群。

branches.en: THE REPORT: numbers and arrows tangled together.
branches.cn: 报告这条线：数字与箭头缠成一团。

branches.en: THE SURVIVAL: both senses test who can keep going.
branches.cn: 生存这条线：两个义项都在考验谁能走下去。

branches.en: THE MESS: crowding and tangling are the same picture.
branches.cn: 杂乱这条线：拥挤与纠缠是同一幅画。

intro.en: Jungle is borrowed from Hindi as a whole; only English endings are added.
intro.cn: jungle 是从印地语整体借来的，只有后面加的英语词尾属于英语。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source; the word is Indic, so latinEntries stays empty.
latinIntro.cn: 它没有拉丁语来源，是印度语系词，所以 latinEntries 留空。

items.exampleCN: 英语写作 jungle，而非 jangal。

items.example: It forms jungled, covered with jungle.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 jungled，被丛林覆盖的。

items.example: It forms jungle cat and jungle law.
items.exampleCN: 它构成 jungle cat 与 jungle law。

items.example: A look-alike with a different origin.
